prompt:

Image2 is the original scene for contextual lighting and role only. Repaint image1 as clean high-definition hand-painted game artwork compatible with restrained Skurfa-style HD environments. Deningrad cut354 slot4 wider bed arrangement. Preserve the thin dark diagonal headboard at upper left, pale grey/beige patterned pillow on a broad blue upper bedcover, the darker grey-blue lower cloth with small repeated weave/fleck marks, the warm wood diagonal footboard at lower right, and the existing small round warm bedside table with a tiny grey/pale vessel at the far right. Keep the blue top cloth distinct from the darker lower patterned cover. Restore fine small-scale textile texture especially on the dark lower cover; avoid plain smooth fabric, stone, boards, new emblems, added objects or moving the side table. Strict canvas: exactly 94:56 aspect ratio, same source silhouette, crop, perspective, visible footprint, internal planes and negative space. Do not center, rotate, widen, pad or recompose it. Refine continuous hand-painted material detail without copying the low-resolution pixel mosaic. Output only this isolated texture on real transparency, with no background, scene, border, labels, text, logo or comparison board. Exactly one finished texture.

Refinement 1:
Correct the high-definition draft in image2 to the exact authoritative source image1 composition. Image3 is original scene context; image4 is an occupancy guide: pale areas are source-visible material, dark grey areas are empty outside the cutout. The previous draft added left/top padding and omitted too much occupied lower-left bed material. Expand and position the bed/table to occupy exactly the guide, with the headboard reaching the source upper-left edge, the blue quilt/pillow in the original upper-left mass, the patterned dark grey-blue lower cover reaching the source lower-left footprint, and warm footboard/table in their original right/lower-right positions. Preserve source camera angles and all material boundaries. Use fine small textile flecks rather than large florals; keep the grey/beige patterned pillow, brighter blue upper cloth, darker patterned lower cloth, warm wood and tiny vessel. Do not treat the occupancy guide as background artwork; final output real transparency with no padding or scene. Exactly 94:56 canvas aspect.

Refinement 2:
Correct only the remaining source footprint of this EnvHD texture. Image1 is authoritative original; image2 is the current painted draft; image3 scene; image4 shows missing original visible areas in bright RED for diagnosis; image5 is a brightened original revealing its dark planes, not final exposure. The missing area at lower left is a broad dark olive-brown bedside underside/shadow-facing plane beneath and beside the blue upper bedcover, running from the LEFT canvas edge at about half image height toward the lower-center edge. It must remain occupied dark opaque material as in the source, not a transparent triangular gap. Paint that dark plane with faint low-contrast original brown/olive texture; do not invent a new beam, leg, object, rug or bright floor. Match the original dark plane position and illumination. Also retain the full source occupied warm footboard underside/table-support footprint at bottom/right and the small source blue-cover edge at upper right; do not shrink these objects. Keep the same blue cover, patterned beige pillow, dark grey-blue lower textile, warm wood and small bedside vessel, with all established camera angles/material boundaries. The red and exposure guides are diagnostic only: never paint red marks or guide backgrounds. Exactly 94:56 canvas, no padding, source-visible occupied regions filled, actual original outside-cutout regions transparent. Output one corrected texture on real transparency.

Larger nearest-color extensions at lower wood/support/shadow edges are recorded, not evidence of exact internal topology or a native seam check.
